title: Cautious Context Steering for Language Model Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2608.05813v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: User context can personalize a language model without per-user fine-tuning, but its influence is not equally helpful at every token. Context Steering (CoS) uses a fixed steering strength throughout generation and requires two LM forward passes per step. We propose Cautious Context Steering (CCS), a lightweight adapter that learns when and how strongly to steer a frozen LM using user context. We train the adapter through cautious distillation, using oracle targets built from predictions with and without context. It learns to match the steered distribution where context helps predict the user's preferred token and the context-free base distribution elsewhere. The CCS adapter outperforms both training-free context-based methods and trained personalization baselines in preference alignment across benchmarks. translated_title: 谨慎上下文引导的语言模型个性化
translated_abstract: 用户上下文可以在无需针对每个用户进行微调的情况下实现语言模型的个性化，但其影响并非在每个 token 上都同样有帮助。上下文引导在整个生成过程中使用固定的引导强度，且每一步都需要两次语言模型前向传播。我们提出了谨慎上下文引导，这是一种轻量级适配器，能够学习何时以及以多强的强度利用用户上下文来引导冻结的语言模型。我们通过谨慎蒸馏来训练该适配器，使用由带上下文和不带上下文的预测构建的 oracle 目标。它学会在上下文有助于预测用户偏好 token 的地方匹配引导后的分布，而在其他地方匹配无上下文的基础分布。CCS 适配器在各个基准测试的偏好对齐方面均优于无需训练的基于上下文的方法和经过训练的个性化基线。我们还引入了 GSM8K-P，用于同时评估任务准确性和任务特定的格式偏好。CCS 实现了较高的格式遵从性……
tldr: 提出轻量级适配器 CCS，通过谨慎蒸馏学习何时以及以多强强度利用用户上下文来引导冻结语言模型，在个性化偏好对齐上超越了现有无需训练的方法和经过训练的个性化基线。
en_tdlr: CCS is a lightweight adapter trained via cautious distillation that learns when and how strongly to steer a frozen LM using user context, outperforming both training-free context-based methods and trained personalization baselines in preference alignment.
